title: Influence bound from derivative cross moments
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional cube and let $p$ be real-valued on that cube. Suppose $f$ is the threshold sign of $p$ at every input and $p$ is nowhere zero. Then the total influence of the real-valued sign representation of $f$ is at most the square root of $n$ plus the sum over ordered pairs of distinct coordinates $i,j$ of the uniform average of $x_i x_j g_i(x)g_j(x)$, where $g_i(x)$ is the sign of the discrete derivative of $p$ in coordinate $i$ at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional cube
At every input, $f$ is the threshold sign of $p$
